title: gynura aurantiaca
intro: Gynura aurantiaca, commonly known as the red spinach, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving blood lipid profiles, thus aiding in the management of cardiovascular diseases. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified in various studies on the plant.
